rules.quote: Write labels without a colon at the end.
rules.violation_condition: a form question label that ends with a colon
rules.why: Clear textual rule banning trailing colons on form labels (G-4).

covers.quote: Write clear labels and ‘help text’ instead of placeholder text.

rules.quote: Don’t put anything in the field the user will type in – this is called ‘placeholder text’.
rules.why: Explicit instruction prohibiting placeholder text in input fields (G-2, G-4).

rules.quote: Never include pre-selected gender or sex options.
rules.violation_condition: a gender or sex option field that is pre-selected by default
rules.why: Absolute prohibition on pre-selected gender/sex options in form inputs (G-2).

covers.quote: Write error messages so they help the user act on the problem.

examples.note: Helpful error message that does not blame user

rules.quote: Do not blame them for making a mistake.
rules.specification: Error messages must describe the required correction or problem without attributing fault to the user.
rules.violation_condition: form error message that blames the user for making an error
rules.why: Textual rule governing the tone and wording of form error messages (G-2, G-4).
